name: s390_pci_mmio_read
synopsis: int syscall(SYS_s390_pci_mmio_read, unsigned long mmio_addr, void *user_buffer, size_t length);
description: The s390_pci_mmio_read() system call reads a specified number of bytes from a PCI MMIO memory location to a user-space buffer. It must be used on Linux Systemz platforms instead of direct memory operations, and the address must belong to a valid PCI MMIO memory page without crossing page boundaries.

parameters.name: mmio_addr
parameters.description: The PCI MMIO memory address to read from.

parameters.name: user_buffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the user-space buffer where the read data will be stored.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Number of bytes to read, which must not exceed the system page size and must not cross a page boundary.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: The address in mmio_addr is invalid.
user_buffer does not point to a valid location in the caller’s address space.
